title: Emrys and the Cover
author: Felix Lockridge
blurb: Gideon Vane, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
